description: The vscode-ext skeleton runs in VS Code's extension host, on the Node release VS Code ships rather than the catalog's Node line, so its @types/node stays on the editor's major. Typings ahead of the host type-check calls that throw at runtime.
VS Code's Node release is the `target` that `gh api repos/microsoft/vscode/contents/remote/.npmrc -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw'` prints. Raise the bound when that major moves.
